articles.summary: Sumant Pustake Named Chief Operating Officer Peter R. Bakkala Named Chief Internal Audit Officer BOSTON, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Beacon Financial Corporation (NYSE: BBT) (the “Company”), the holding company of Beacon Bank (the “Bank”), today announced the appointments of Sumant Pustake to the role of Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately, and Peter R. Bakkala to the role of Chief Internal Audit Officer effective November 30, 2026. Sumant Pustake As Chief Operating Officer, Mr. Pustake will be responsible for leading the execution of the Bank’s strategic priorities and overseeing enterprise program management, with a focus on driving revenue growth, optimizing expenses and improving operational efficiency. His responsibilities will span enterprise product strategy and management, digital strategy, enterprise data and analytics, artificial intelligence strategy, incentive compensation analytics, and all facets of client experience, including Call Center operations.
